profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer
profile.summary:
As a freelance web developer with over 10 years of experience, I create front end user interfaces for websites and applications that are accessible, responsive, and engaging. I work with clients across various industries and sectors, delivering customized solutions that meet their needs and expectations.

I am proficient in using technologies and tools, such as HTML5, CSS/Sass, JavaScript (ES6+), and libraries such as React.js, jQuery, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS. I also have a strong background in graphic design, landing page layout design, digital photography, and photo editing/retouching. I enjoy learning new skills and staying updated with the latest trends and best practices in web development. My passion is to create web experiences that are user-friendly, aesthetically pleasing, and functional.

Currently, I enjoy building full-stack applications with cutting edge technology and accessibility in mind. My specialties include HTML, CSS (Sass/SCSS), JavaScript (React.js/Next.js Vue.js, Node.js/express).
